title: The Study
what: The story turned back into text by a speech-recognition model running on this PC: every word with its start and end time, and subtitle files ready to use.

inputs.label: Audio
inputs.value: the bedtime story from the children's room (80 s)

snippet:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:3900/v1", api_key="local")
tr = client.audio.transcriptions.create(model="whisper-1",
    file=open("story.mp3", "rb"), response_format="verbose_json",
    timestamp_granularities=["word"])
print(tr.words[0])  # word, start, end
